title: throw an error if refresh was called before start
body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe 🙏**

When Implementing Vue InstantSearch, I used `refresh` bound to the wrong "this", which silently didn't work

**Describe the solution you'd like 🤔**

Change the guard from "this.helper" to "this.isStarted" and throw an error "can not call refresh before start" if it hasn't started

**Describe alternatives you've considered ✨**

* Removing the guard all together, but the error would be cryptic
* move InstantSearch from a class to a factory so it doesn't need to be bound anymore

**Additional context**

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/a35cb0b7bc0cfbd83fa98648db31f0a6d002dd2f/src/lib/InstantSearch.js#L312-L316
